images.title: A rectangle with a side in parts
images.purpose: Show a rectangle 20 cm wide whose height is marked in two parts, 5 cm and 7 cm, with a dotted line between the parts, so that the whole height is seen as the parts added.
images.composition: The rectangle on the left with its width and the two parts of its height marked, three lines of working on the right.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. At the top, centred at x 728 and y 62, the heading A rectangle with a side in parts in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px). Left, one rectangle 500 by 300 px (20 units by 12 units of 25 px) at x 150 to 650 and y 150 to 450, filled amber #E69F00 with a thick dark #2B2B2B outline (6 px). A thin dotted dark line (3 px) runs across the full width at y 275, so the rectangle is cut into an upper part 500 by 125 px and a lower part 500 by 175 px. Above the top side, centred at x 400 and y 110, the label 20 cm with a thin dark arrow line under it spanning x 150 to 650 at y 136 with an arrowhead at each end. Left of the left side there are 2 labelled arrows with an arrowhead at each end at x 130: one spanning y 150 to 275 with the label 5 cm to its left at y 212, and one spanning y 275 to 450 with the label 7 cm to its left at y 362. To the right, at x 800, three lines of text: 5 + 7 = 12 at y 250, 20 × 12 = 240 at y 330 and Area 240 square cm at y 410 (40 px, dark #1F2937). In all 1 rectangle, 1 dotted line, 3 labelled arrows and 3 lines of text. No other number and no other text anywhere. Nothing else in the frame.
labels: A rectangle with a side in parts
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a height marked with a single number, or parts other than 5 cm and 7 cm
any value other than the listed labels
images.takeaway: When a side is marked in parts, add the parts to get the whole side, then multiply.
images.description: A rectangle 20 cm wide with its height marked in two parts, 5 cm and 7 cm, so the height is 12 cm and the area 240 square cm.
images.context: Concept image for A Side Given in Parts. It follows the idea of the figure at the end of your maths book (a rectangle with a side marked in parts) and uses the numbers of this concept's own example.
images.teaching_notes: Let the student add the two parts before multiplying. The slip to watch: using only one of the parts as the height.

image_decisions.why: The two arrows on the left side show the parts that make the whole height.
